name: Hong Leong Industries Berhad
summary: Hong Leong Industries Berhad, an investment holding company, engages in the manufacture and sale of consumer and industrial products in Malaysia, Australia, Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, Taiwan, and internationally. The company manufactures, assembles, and distributes motorcycles, engines, spare parts, scooters, and related parts and products; and manufactures and sells ceramic tiles. It is also involved in the distribution, trading, and provision of services in marine-related products, such as outboard motors, as well as offers after-sales services.
